_comment: Riverside Library's own four checks, and NOTHING ELSE. This is a fragment, not a registry: it is merged with the suite's own registry at run time by merge_registry.py. Do not copy the suite's 61 entries in here -- if you do, they freeze at the version you copied and you will never be told that the suite has improved a check or added one. See README.md, step 3.

checks.title: Book missing an ISBN
checks.description: A lib:Book has no lib:isbn value. Riverside's ordering system keys on the ISBN, so a title without one cannot be reordered or matched against a supplier's catalogue.
checks.remediation: Add lib:isbn to the book, or correct the import that should have supplied it. If the item genuinely has no ISBN (a pamphlet or local history sheet), record it as a different class than lib:Book.
checks.cucumber_scenario: Every book can be reordered from its ISBN

checks.title: Loan does not record a borrower
checks.description: A lib:Loan has no lib:borrowedBy value. The book is recorded as out, but nobody is recorded as having it, so it can never be chased or returned.
checks.remediation: Add lib:borrowedBy to the loan. If the book was returned, delete the loan record rather than leaving it borrower-less.
checks.cucumber_scenario: Every loan names the person holding the book

checks.title: Book has no shelf mark
checks.description: A lib:Book has no lib:shelfMark. The record is otherwise usable, but a borrower cannot locate the book on the shelves.
checks.remediation: Add lib:shelfMark using Riverside's classification, e.g. "PR-6013". If the title is held only as an e-book, give it the electronic-only shelf mark rather than leaving it blank.
checks.cucumber_scenario: Every book can be found on a shelf

checks.title: Book catalogued with no copies held
checks.description: A lib:Book has lib:copies 0. Nothing is wrong: the catalogue is correctly reporting that the library holds none. Reported so that acquisitions can see it.
checks.remediation: No fix is required. Order a copy, or withdraw the title from the catalogue if it will not be replaced.
checks.cucumber_scenario: Titles held in no copies are visible to acquisitions
